review.why: Finds out what someone really wants before building: a useful first message, approaches to choose from, a short approved design, then a plan.
review.summary: Starts by asking what is actually known about the request. A clear small task is done at once; otherwise it reads existing context, then sends a first message that restates the goal, flags surprises and asks one open question about why. It requires choosing an approach, writing a short design and getting approval before the planning skill. A visual companion and a spike option exist.
strengths: Reads the project first and never asks what the context already answers
Offers to skip the conversation when the user did not ask for one
Ends in an approved design before any implementation
cautions: Process-heavy: extra rounds for small changes
Written for the surrounding skill set, which it names
Later sections and bundled scripts are not read here
